versions.changelog:
Initial public release providing cross-client analytics and advisory insights for Greek accounting firms.

- Surfaces trends, anomalies, and risks across client financial data.
- Provides portfolio-level and client-level analysis with plain-English, confidence-rated findings.
- Read-only operation; outputs reports to /data/reports/analytics/.
- No external services or credentials required; analyzes local financial data only.
- Includes OpenClaw commands for trend analysis, risk scoring, benchmarking, anomaly detection, and scheduled advisory reports.
